mechanism: Establish one clearly adult original subject, one personal device and an ordinary environment baseline. Use one visible device-wear or activation action as the sole switch into the heightened state. Change performance, camera rhythm and bounded environmental accents while preserving identity and geography. Keep surrounding public behavior plausible so the private state remains legible by contrast. Return camera and subject motion to a stable baseline in the same environment, with device state visibly resolved. The reusable mechanism is the ordered baseline, trigger, continuity, controlled escalation and terminal proof—not the source identities, brands, wording, locations, props, exact styling, choreography, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly adult original subject, one personal device and an ordinary environment baseline.
invariants.purpose: Makes the baseline measurable before the mechanism changes it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later change has no trustworthy reference state.

invariants.rule: Use one visible device-wear or activation action as the sole switch into the heightened state.
invariants.purpose: Binds the first visible change to a specific cause rather than decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a visible trigger, the transition reads as an arbitrary edit.

invariants.rule: Change performance, camera rhythm and bounded environmental accents while preserving identity and geography.
invariants.purpose: Preserves identity, material or spatial continuity through the middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without continuity, the sequence becomes unrelated montage or identity drift.

invariants.rule: Keep surrounding public behavior plausible so the private state remains legible by contrast.
invariants.purpose: Raises intensity or information while retaining the same readable grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without controlled escalation, the middle either plateaus or turns into noise.

invariants.rule: Return camera and subject motion to a stable baseline in the same environment, with device state visibly resolved.
invariants.purpose: Provides a terminal proof that resolves the mechanism instead of merely stopping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without terminal proof, the promised result or reversal remains unverified.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source woman, face, hair, headphones, hoodie and jeans
source commercial street, storefronts, pedestrians and golden-hour look
source exact listening, walking, dancing and facial performance
source camera tracking, lensing, glitch details and timing
source creator identity, Seedance 2.0 claim, platform marks and post wording
